item.title: Gold prices surge again on 8 January; Silver also gains momentum
item.description: Gold prices continued their upward trend on January 8, rising sharply across major Indian cities, while silver also recorded a strong jump. Driven by global geopolitical tensions, a weaker dollar and sustained central bank buying, precious metals remain in focus.

item.title: Prayagraj gears up for Mahamagh Mela with 9,000-foot bathing ghats ahead of 2 Shahi Snan
item.description: Preparations for Magh Mela 2026 in Prayagraj are in full swing as authorities focus on two major bathing festivals, Makar Sankranti and Mauni Amavasya. With a rare astrological alignment after 75 years, the event is being termed Mahamagh Mela.

item.title: After Venezuela, India, China and Brazil in US crosshairs as Trump clears 500% tariff sanctions bill
item.description: The Trump administration has approved a bill under which a 500 percent tariff will be imposed on India, Brazil, and China. This means these three countries will have to pay 500 percent more tax on their exports to the US.

item.title: Sensex Slips in Pre-Open Trade, Nifty Hovers Near 26,100
item.description: Indian equity markets indicated a weak opening on Thursday as benchmark indices traded lower in pre-open deals. The Sensex slipped over 180 points, while the Nifty50 hovered near the 26,100 mark. Weak global cues and cautious investor sentiment weighed on markets.

item.title: Makar Sankranti 2026: SCR to run 150 special trains for Tirupati, Shirdi and key routes
item.description: This initiative is aimed at easing congestion, reducing waiting lists, and offering passengers more convenient travel options during one of the busiest periods of the year.

item.title: Bangladesh election violence escalates as BNP leader shot dead in Dhaka
item.description: Political violence has intensified in Bangladesh ahead of the national elections, following the shooting death of a senior BNP volunteer wing leader in Dhaka. The attack, carried out by unidentified assailants, has triggered protests and renewed accusations against the interim administration.

item.title: Bangladesh: BNP leader shot dead as Pre-Election violence escalates
item.description: The surge in violence ahead of the national elections scheduled for February 12 in Bangladesh is raising questions about the interim government led by Muhammad Yunus.

item.title: Which is India’s safest city for women? Delhi, UP, Bihar miss top 10
item.description: A new report by the Avatar Group ranks Indian cities based on women’s safety, inclusion and career opportunities. Bengaluru secured the top position, followed by Chennai, while no city from Delhi, Uttar Pradesh or Bihar made it to the top 10.

item.title: Tilak Varma undergoes surgery; T20 World Cup participation in doubt
item.description: Indian cricketer Tilak Varma underwent emergency surgery after sustaining an injury during the Vijay Hazare Trophy. The operation was successful, but his participation in the upcoming India vs New Zealand T20 series is uncertain.

item.title: ED raids in 6 states at 40 locations
item.description: The searches are part of an ongoing probe into financial irregularities linked to fraudulent job offers in the Railways.
